messages:
morgan: Morning team — quick async check (what I did / blockers / today). TL;DR: RC built for model-service v2, need one last CR, infra rollout target 11:30 PT, asking for a smoke test after rollout. :rocket:

morgan: Yesterday — finished perf tuning for kv-cache, landed changes to prefetch logic, ran load sweep on staging. Blocker — intermittent auth failures observed in canary (low frequency).

devon: Shipped a small metrics fix (prometheus labels). No blockers from my side. I can help monitor the rollout and do smoke tests.

jia: Taking PR review for model-service v2 now (PR #789). Will try to finish within the hour. If I see anything big I’ll post inline.

anita: Heads-up: certificate rotation for the internal KMS is scheduled at 11:20 PT by infra. Might cause short auth 401s for a minute. Recommend scheduling rollout after rotation completes or coordinate with infra.

morgan: Good catch @anita. I can delay the rollout 20m. Would prefer to avoid pairing two risky ops.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Deployment job queued: model-service-v2 -> staging (user: morgan). ETA: 10m. Job id: deploy-20240505-331.

chris: I’ll be the primary on-call for the rollout window. Ping me on pager if error-rate spikes >3% or p95 latency increases >200ms.

emma: No blockers here. Will run the smoke test suite and then a quick embedding/regression check after the canary.

jia: Quick question — are we toggling batching for this release? The change touches kv-cache interaction and batching policy could affect memory.

devon: Yes, batching toggles are in config service -> MODEL_BATCH_POLICY. Default will be 'adaptive' for staging. If you want to force small batch size for canary, set: 

```
# curl example to set policy
curl -X POST https://config.internal/api/v1/set \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{"key":"MODEL_BATCH_POLICY","value":"small"}'
```

devon: I can flip to 'small' for the canary if we want minimal memory pressure.

morgan: Ask list: 1) @jia please prioritize PR #789 review; 2) @devon please set policy to 'small' for canary and document the change in the release notes; 3) @emma please run smoke + embedding sanity; 4) @chris monitor on-call metrics during rollout; 5) @anita confirm KMS rotation window or we shift to 11:50 PT.

anita: I can move rotation to 11:50 PT; will update infra calendar in 2m.

jia: Reviewing now, leaving inline comments. Nothing blocking so far besides a TODO to add an assertion in model_state_test.

devon: Policy set to 'small' for the canary. Logged in release notes under release-2024-05-05.md.

morgan: Thanks all. I’ll wait for the green from infra and from @jia before kicking the staging rollout. If anyone hits a blocker, drop it here or DM. :thumbsup:

emma: Smoke tests passed locally. Will run the full canary suite after the infra go-ahead.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Deployment started: model-service-v2 -> staging (job id: deploy-20240505-331). Started by: morgan.

chris: Saw a small spike during rollout warmup — p95 +130ms for ~30s then back to baseline. Monitoring closely.

morgan: Great — will hold until you say "green".

jia: PR #789 approved and merged. Added the assertion in model_state_test as requested.

chris: Green — rollout looks stable after 10 minutes. No auth errors seen.

morgan: Awesome. Thanks everyone. Follow-ups: add a short note about batching interactions to the runtime docs, and schedule a postmortem in case we see recurrence of auth blips.

devon: I'll draft the docs note this afternoon.

anita: Rotation rescheduled to 11:50 PT and posted to infra calendar.

emma: Closing loop on smoke: embeddings OK, no regressions in sample prompts.

morgan: Closing this thread — if anything else pops up, re-open here. Have a good day! :sparkles:
